verdict.rationale: Extensive docs confirm a well-documented Python SDK covering partition, enrich, chunk, embed, and workflow/job management (unstructured-docs-4, 7, 19, 23, 30, 35, 36), but there is no evidence anywhere in the pack of an official TypeScript/JS SDK - only Python SDK and generic REST clients are mentioned. missing for 10: TypeScript SDK evidence, explicit coverage of jobs API via SDK (vs REST-only), independent developer corroboration of SDK ergonomics
